11-zoomable-treemap.visual_critic_note: Deliberate HCL-based color hierarchy with depth-varying lightness shows real design intent, and the clean header/legend/breadcrumb chrome is well-proportioned, but leaf labels are tiny and dense at root zoom level, making the initial view feel cramped rather than inviting exploration.
11-zoomable-treemap.encoding_integrity_note: Treemap area encoding is honest (.sum() correctly accumulates file sizes, data-driven x/y domains via treemap layout), categorical color is appropriate, and zoom uses correct domain-swap technique, but leaf colors share the data-generation PRNG causing color-order coupling, and the key function uses fragile string concatenation that risks collisions.
11-zoomable-treemap.cognitive_load_note: Single-view zoom model with 8-color tonal hierarchy and breadcrumb navigation keeps cognitive load low despite 471 files — leaf labels are unreadable at root level but the progressive disclosure interaction is exactly the right mitigation.
